ex.en: She bought a black leather jacket at the market last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末她在市场上买了一件黑色皮夹克。

words.note: 常作定语，如 leather shoes；真皮说 genuine leather。

ex.en: The book offers valuable insights into how children learn languages.
ex.zh: 这本书对儿童如何学习语言提出了宝贵见解。

words.note: 常用搭配 insight into sth；具体见解多用复数 insights。

ex.en: Despite the earthquake, the old temple remained intact.
ex.zh: 尽管发生了地震，这座古庙仍完好无损。

words.note: 多与 remain、keep 连用；in-（不）+tact（接触）即未被触动。

ex.en: She was instrumental in setting up the school's reading programme.
ex.zh: 她在建立学校阅读计划中起了重要作用。

words.note: 表“起重要作用”：be instrumental in doing sth。

ex.en: The curtains are made of a light cotton fabric.
ex.zh: 窗帘是用轻薄的棉布做的。

words.note: 除织物外还指结构，如 the fabric of society。

ex.en: The new treatment is considered revolutionary in the fight against cancer.
ex.zh: 这种新疗法在抗癌方面被视为革命性的。

words.note: 由 revolution 加 -ary 构成；作名词指革命者。

ex.en: The unemployment rate rose sharply during the economic crisis.
ex.zh: 经济危机期间失业率急剧上升。

words.note: 不可数名词；常见于 unemployment rate 等搭配。

ex.en: Juvenile crime has fallen in the city over the past five years.
ex.zh: 过去五年该市青少年犯罪有所下降。

words.note: 正式用语，指少年的；法律语境常与 crime 搭配。

ex.en: The new safety rules will come into force next month.
ex.zh: 新的安全规定将于下个月生效。

words.note: force sb to do sth；come into force 指生效。

ex.en: Her teacher was sympathetic and gave her more time to finish.
ex.zh: 老师很体谅她，给了她更多时间完成。

words.note: 除同情外还表赞同，如 be sympathetic to a plan。

ex.en: The equipment needs periodic checks to make sure it is safe.
ex.zh: 设备需要定期检查以确保安全。

words.note: periodic 指定期的；periodical 作名词指期刊。

ex.en: The charity handles the distribution of food to local families.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构负责向当地家庭分发食物。

words.note: 由 distribute 变来；兼指分发、分配、分布。

ex.en: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek.
ex.zh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语。

words.note: derive from 表来源；derive sth from 表获得。

ex.en: The hall has a seating capacity of about five hundred.
ex.zh: 这个大厅可容纳约五百人就座。

words.note: 兼指容量与能力；in one's capacity as 指以某身份。

ex.en: Many students find it hard to cope with the pressure of exams.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得难以应对考试压力。

words.note: 必须与 with 连用；比 deal with 更强调承受力。

ex.en: I often overhear my colleagues talking about football by the coffee machine.
ex.zh: 我常无意中听到同事在咖啡机旁聊足球。

words.note: 过去式 overheard；强调无意中听到，不同于 listen。

ex.en: He threw a dart at the board, but it missed the centre.
ex.zh: 他朝镖盘掷了一支飞镖，但没打中中心。

words.note: 作动词指猛冲；dart a glance at sb 指飞快看一眼。

ex.en: The engineers found a serious flaw in the design of the bridge.
ex.zh: 工程师们在大桥设计中发现了一个严重缺陷。

words.note: 常用搭配 a flaw in sth；形容词 flawed 指有缺陷的。

ex.en: Heavy rain will saturate the fields and flood the low roads.
ex.zh: 大雨会使田地浸透，并淹没低洼的道路。

words.note: 常用被动 be saturated with；名词 saturation。

ex.en: The film features a young actress from a small town.
ex.zh: 这部电影由一位来自小镇的年轻女演员主演。

words.note: 作动词指以…为特色、由…主演；key feature 指特点。

ex.en: We had to stop because the car had a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我们不得不停车，因为车胎瘪了。

words.note: flat 还指一套公寓；flat tyre 指瘪胎。

ex.en: She asserted that the report was based on false information.
ex.zh: 她断言那份报告基于虚假信息。

words.note: 后接 that 从句表断言；assert oneself 指显自信。

ex.en: The argument reached its climax when both sides refused to talk.
ex.zh: 双方拒绝交谈时，争论达到了高潮。

words.note: 常用 reach a climax；形容词 climactic 指高潮的。

ex.en: I cannot recall meeting him before, though his face looks familiar.
ex.zh: 我想不起以前见过他，虽然他的脸看着眼熟。

words.note: recall doing 表记得做过；recall a product 指召回。

ex.en: The garden is small and rectangular, with a path down the middle.
ex.zh: 花园不大，呈长方形，中间有一条小路。

words.note: 由 rectangle 加 -ular 构成，重音在第二音节。

ex.en: The bird flapped its wings and rose slowly above the trees.
ex.zh: 那只鸟拍打翅膀，慢慢升到树梢上方。

words.note: 指翅膀或布片拍动；in a flap 表慌乱。

ex.en: Please give me the precise time and place of the meeting.
ex.zh: 请告诉我会议的准确时间和地点。

words.note: 与 exact 近义，但更强调细节严谨；副词 precisely。

ex.en: It would be sensible to book the tickets well in advance.
ex.zh: 提前订好票是明智的做法。

words.note: 注意与 sensitive（敏感的）区分，sensible 指明智。

ex.en: The neighbours raised an objection to the plan for a new road.
ex.zh: 邻居们对新修道路的计划提出了异议。

words.note: 常用 objection to sth；动词 object 也接 to。

ex.en: Clean water is a precious resource that many people take for granted.
ex.zh: 清洁的水是许多人想当然的宝贵资源。

words.note: 形容量少而宝贵；precious metal 指贵金属。
